issues.problem: The heading gives the unit as euros ('Amounts in euros (EUR)'), but the workbook amounts are in thousands of euros. The amounts are printed unscaled, so every figure would be read as 1,000 times too small (for example, revenue would read as EUR 51,669 instead of EUR 51.7 million). The heading should say 'Amounts in thousands of euros (EUR '000)'.
issues.evidence: FS!A2 = "EUR x 1,000"; FS!C6 Sales revenue = 51669, printed as Revenue 51,669 under 'Amounts in euros (EUR)'
